summary: defaultdict calls its default factory when indexing a missing key, inserts that new value and returns it.
documentation: defaultdict calls its default factory when indexing a missing key, inserts that new value and returns it. A list factory creates a separate list for each new key, which supports straightforward grouping.
inputs: A callable default factory and optional initial data.
returns: A dictionary subclass with factory-backed missing-key indexing.
caution: get does not trigger the factory. Pass the callable list, not an already-created shared list instance.
scenarios: Collect filenames under their export category.
Organize product IDs by supplier while retaining row order.
title: Group appointments by branch
problem: Input is an array of [branchString, integerAppointmentId] pairs. Return a plain dictionary mapping each branch to its list of IDs in input order. Keep repeated IDs. Empty input yields an empty dictionary.
goal: Use collections.defaultdict or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Use defaultdict(list), append each ID, then convert the result to dict.
